title: Stem-changing verbs: querer, poder, preferir, pensar, jugar
summary: The 'boot' verbs: e→ie and o→ue in every form except nosotros and vosotros.
focus: Present tense of e→ie, o→ue and u→ue stem-changing verbs; querer/poder + infinitive
content:
## What changes

In some verbs the **stressed vowel of the stem** changes in the present tense. The endings are the regular ones. The change happens in **yo, tú, él, ellos** but not in **nosotros, vosotros**, so the changing forms make a boot shape in the table.

## e → ie: querer, preferir, pensar, entender, empezar

| | querer (to want) | preferir (to prefer) | pensar (to think) |
|---|---|---|---|
| yo | qu**ie**ro | pref**ie**ro | p**ie**nso |
| tú | qu**ie**res | pref**ie**res | p**ie**nsas |
| él / ella / usted | qu**ie**re | pref**ie**re | p**ie**nsa |
| nosotros/as | queremos | preferimos | pensamos |
| vosotros/as | queréis | preferís | pensáis |
| ellos / ellas / ustedes | qu**ie**ren | pref**ie**ren | p**ie**nsan |

## o → ue: poder, dormir, volver, costar

| | poder (can, to be able) | dormir (to sleep) |
|---|---|---|
| yo | p**ue**do | d**ue**rmo |
| tú | p**ue**des | d**ue**rmes |
| él / ella / usted | p**ue**de | d**ue**rme |
| nosotros/as | podemos | dormimos |
| vosotros/as | podéis | dormís |
| ellos / ellas / ustedes | p**ue**den | d**ue**rmen |

*Jugar* (to play a sport or game) is the one **u → ue** verb: *juego, juegas, juega, jugamos, jugáis, juegan*.

## Querer, poder, preferir + infinitive

- *Quiero comer.* (I want to eat.)
- *¿Puedes ayudar?* (Can you help?)
- *Prefiero ir a pie.* (I'd rather walk.)
- *Pienso que es caro.* (I think it's expensive.)

**Deber + infinitive** (should / must) and **soler + infinitive** (to usually do; o→ue: *suelo, sueles…*) work the same way: *Debes descansar. Suelo levantarme a las siete.*

vocabulary.example: La clase empieza a las nueve.
Vuelvo a casa a las seis.
vocabulary.example_meaning: I go back home at six.

quiz.explanation: e → ie in the yo form: quiero.
Nosotros keeps the original stem: queremos.
hints: Nosotros is outside the boot, so the stem stays.

quiz.explanation: Vosotros has no stem change: jugáis.
hints: Nosotros and vosotros keep the stem.

quiz.explanation: Querer is followed directly by the infinitive.
Jugar is the u → ue verb: juego.
Dormir: o → ue in ellos: duermen.

listening.note: New word: la pregunta = the question.

listening.meaning: Do you want a coffee with milk?

listening.text: Mis hermanos juegan al fútbol los sábados.
listening.meaning: My brothers play football on Saturdays.
Can you open the door, please?

listening.text: Pienso que este coche es muy caro.
listening.meaning: I think this car is very expensive.

listening.text: Debes dormir ocho horas todos los días.
listening.meaning: You should sleep eight hours every day.

listening.text: Suelo volver a casa a las seis de la tarde.
listening.meaning: I usually get home at six in the evening.

listening.text: Queremos volver a Madrid, pero no podemos porque mañana trabajamos muy temprano.
listening.meaning: We want to go back to Madrid, but we can't because tomorrow we work very early.
listening.note: No stem change in the nosotros form: queremos, podemos.

conversations.title: Can you come?
conversations.scenario: Dani invites Marta to play football, but she has other ideas.

lines.speaker: a
lines.meaning: Do you want to play football on Sunday?

lines.speaker: b
lines.text: No puedo. Prefiero descansar; duermo poco esta semana.
lines.meaning: I can't. I'd rather rest; I'm sleeping little this week.

lines.speaker: a
lines.text: ¿Qué piensas de un café por la tarde?
lines.meaning: What do you think about a coffee in the afternoon?

lines.speaker: b
lines.text: Sí, puedo a las cinco. ¿Dónde solemos ir?
lines.meaning: Yes, I can at five. Where do we usually go?

lines.speaker: a
lines.text: Al bar de siempre. ¿Entiendes el menú nuevo?
lines.meaning: To the usual bar. Do you understand the new menu?

lines.speaker: b
lines.text: No entiendo nada, pero quiero probar la tarta.
lines.meaning: I don't understand anything, but I want to try the cake.

lines.speaker: a
lines.text: Empieza a las cinco entonces. ¡Y debes dormir más!
lines.meaning: It starts at five then. And you should sleep more!

lines.speaker: b
lines.text: Vuelvo a casa temprano hoy, lo prometo.
lines.meaning: I'm going home early today, I promise.

bites.title: Draw the boot
bites.rule: Circle yo, tú, él and ellos in the table and you get a boot. Those four forms change the stem. Nosotros and vosotros are outside the boot and stay regular.
bites.example: Yo quiero ir, pero nosotros queremos descansar.
bites.example_meaning: I want to go, but we want to rest.

bites.title: e becomes ie
bites.rule: In querer, preferir, pensar, entender and empezar the stressed e becomes ie: quiero, prefiero, pienso, entiendo, empieza.
bites.example_meaning: I don't understand the new menu.

bites.title: o becomes ue
bites.rule: Poder, dormir, volver and costar change o to ue: puedo, duermo, vuelvo, cuesta. Jugar is the only u → ue verb: juego.
bites.example_meaning: How much does the coffee cost?

bites.title: Then add an infinitive
bites.rule: Querer, poder, preferir, deber and soler take an infinitive right after them. Use no 'a' and do not conjugate the second verb.

sorts.title: Stem change or not?
sorts.why: Only nosotros and vosotros keep the plain stem. Every other person changes it.

sorts.title: Which change?
sorts.why: Look at the stem vowel. E becomes ie, o becomes ue, and the u of jugar also becomes ue.

sorts.title: Real form or wrong form?
sorts.why: The stem changes in yo, tú, él and ellos only, so nosotros never gets ie or ue and the other forms always do.

spots.sentence: Hoy no podo ir a la fiesta.
spots.why: Poder is o → ue in yo: puedo.
Ellos is inside the boot, so the stem changes: duermen.
Nosotros is outside the boot, so there is no change: podemos.

spots.sentence: Mis padres pensan que es caro.
spots.why: Pensar is e → ie for ellos: piensan.

spots.sentence: Vosotros juegáis al fútbol los sábados.
spots.why: Vosotros keeps the original stem: jugáis.

I don't understand the new menu.
Today I'd rather rest at home.
We can come back at six.
